sourceNotes.access: Census 2011 values reweighted from the rebuilt 2009 ward map to the historical 2016 ward geography; approximate, not current observations.
sourceNotes.growth: Google Open Buildings Temporal 2016-2023 building-change signal; not a population or household estimate.
sourceNotes.equity: HMWSSB monthly section booking/delivery records; section metrics are exact, ward placement is approximate.
sourceNotes.fieldChecks: E5 screening: the peer median and a negative-binomial model must both flag a ward (the spatial models did not converge); flags are hypotheses for field review and do not establish unmet need or entitlement.

equity.interpretation: Concentration of observed bookings, not unequal need or proven neglect

fieldCheckLimitations: Low bookings cannot identify unmet need or a reporting probability.
Reference mean is a need-covariate model benchmark; interval covers that mean only.
Peer matching excludes each target; Bayesian reference fits are in-sample unless held out.
Only officer field observations supply empirical labels; model flags are hypotheses.
Configured quantiles/priors are engineering choices; ties can exceed the nominal fraction.
Growth signals are context only; they never scale household exposure.
